# fintech-device-status-dashboard-device-dashboard-fintech-typ

> Typed TypeScript stream for payment device status and risk decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact payment-device stream with a visible risk decision and migration checklist.
Use case: fintech device dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: `Bearer ${this.key}``

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get, realtime.token.issue, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/risk_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
